description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Blitzcrank''' empowers their next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 5 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], deal 100% AD (+ 25% AP) '''bonus''' physical damage and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knock up]] the target for 1 second. This damage is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers.
description.text: Active: Blitzcrank empowers their next basic attack within 5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, deal 100% AD (+ 25% AP) bonus physical damage and knock up the target for 1 second. This damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description3.raw: ''Power Fist [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Blitzcrank's''' basic attack timer.''
description3.text: Power Fist resets Blitzcrank's basic attack timer.

notes.raw: * ''Power Fist'' deals [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]], but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Ability damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]]. ** This includes the [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] itself. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] prevents the [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knockup]] and the damage, including the damage of the basic attack itself.(unexpected) * The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] during the [[:Attack speed#Windup|attack's windup]]. * The knockup does not trigger against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]], [[jungle plants]], and [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]]. ** The ''Power Fist'' buff does not get consumed if the knockup doesn't trigger, allowing '''Blitzcrank''' to repeatedly attack structures for bonus damage.(unexpected) * The target is displaced a short distance during the [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knockup]] in a random direction.
notes.text:
Power Fist deals basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage.
* This includes the basic attack itself.
Spell shield prevents the knockup and the damage, including the damage of the basic attack itself.(unexpected)
The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become untargetable during the attack's windup.
The knockup does not trigger against structures, jungle plants, and wards.
* The Power Fist buff does not get consumed if the knockup doesn't trigger, allowing Blitzcrank to repeatedly attack structures for bonus damage.(unexpected)
The target is displaced a short distance during the knockup in a random direction.
